docs.title: Stefan Peele — Technical Documentation
docs.text: Network engineering lab documentation, configurations, and technical references built during a 13-week sprint on physical enterprise Cisco hardware.

docs.title: What's Here
docs.text:
• Cisco Lab — Router, switching, L3, and ASA firewall projects documented from a physical lab environment
  • End Device Lab — Proxmox, Linux, Windows, and security operations
  • Reference — Command cheatsheets, failure mode library, and protocol deep dives
  • About — The lab, the hardware, and the methodology

docs.title: The Lab
docs.text:
Physical enterprise network lab running:

  • Cisco 1921 Router
  • Cisco 2960X Switches x2
  • Cisco 3560X L3 Switch
  • Cisco ASA 5506-X Firewall
  • Lenovo M700 x3 (Proxmox, Security, Linux)
  • HP ProDesk (Windows endpoint)

226 structured lab projects. CCNA in progress. Everything documented here.
